name: UPC Technology Corporation
summary: UPC Technology Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells petrochemical products in Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, Japan, the Middle East, New Zealand, Australia, the United States, and Canada. It offers acids, phthalic and malic anhydride, plasticizers, unsaturated polyester resins, polyols, fatty esters, and other specialty chemicals for industrial applications. The company also engages in logistics, road transportation, warehouse storage, bulk chemical jetty operation, and tank farm activities. In addition, it is involved in investment and trading, and real estate management activities. The company was formerly known as Union Petrochemical Corp. and changed its name to UPC Technology Corporation in 2001. UPC Technology Corporation was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
